mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (including hypomagnesemia and hypokalemia); hydrochlorothiazide also causes potassium and magnesium depletion, compounding electrolyte abnormalities and increasing risk of cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor electrolytes (K+, Mg2+, Ca2+) closely, ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy, consider potassium-sparing alternative or supplementation, and monitor cardiac rhythm given arrhythmia risk from combined electrolyte depletion.
